store.summary: Share the aircraft you receive with Flightradar24
store.description:
ZeroFeed24 turns the CardputerZero into a Flightradar24 feeder. Plug an RTL-SDR dongle with a 1090 MHz antenna into the USB-A port, fit the Cap LoRa-1262 with GPS, connect to Wi-Fi and start feeding.

- Enter your FR24 sharing key, or get a new one from the app through Flightradar24's own signup.
- Antenna position and altitude from the GPS of the M5Stack Cap LoRa-1262.
- Downloads Flightradar24's official fr24feed by itself at the first start, checked against Flightradar24's signature. No root, no sudo.
- Feeds only while the app is open and you started it: nothing runs in the background.
- FEED page: link to FR24, radar ID, aircraft sent and heard, receiver and MLAT state.
- Receiver gain and PPM, service log, light and dark theme. English and Italian.

The package bundles readsb (GPL-3.0). fr24feed is Flightradar24's software, downloaded from their repository under their licence.
